rv.q: The Very Hungry Caterpillar Show is the perfect combination of art and audience.
It's earnest, colorful, artsy and will hold your kid in awe for 60 solid minutes.

cn.t: Critics praise this Eric Carle adaptation as a visual feast that captivates young audiences for its full hour, with vibrant colors and minimal narration letting the beloved characters shine in an artful, engaging production.
